ABOUT US

A little pink house of coffee and cake

Die Pienk Huis is a neighbourhood cafe and custom cake studio, open for breakfast, brunch and all-day treats — with a cake counter that changes daily and a custom order book for life's celebrations.

Cafe, daily

Sourdough toasties, savoury pies and a full warm-drinks menu, served from our floral-filled cafe room.

Custom cakes

Number cakes, novelty cakes, baby & bridal shower cakes — handcrafted to order for your celebration.

Catering & DIY

Canapé platters for events, plus DIY cookie decorating boxes for a sweet activity at home.

OUR MENU

Cafe & drinks menu

Everything on our all-day cafe menu, from breakfast to something savoury, plus our full drinks and milkshake list. Prices in ZAR.
